checkResults.description: Model produced component code with exports/imports
No aria-hidden on placeholder rows — they must participate in the accessible tree for role-based locators
Named exports only — no default exports
Must render a tbody element for placeholder rows

RQD-02.prompt_excerpt: Write a DataTable component. It receives `rows: Row[]` and `loading: boolean`. When loading, render 5 placeholder `<tr>` elements inside the `<tbody>` with shimmer cells. When loaded, render the real rows. The table has role="table" with proper semantic markup. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file.
RQD-02.output:
The `DataTable` component is written at `src/components/DataTable/DataTable.tsx` with:

- **Semantic markup**: `<table role="table">`, `<thead>`, `<tbody>`, `<th scope="col">`, `<td>`
- **Loading state**: 5 placeholder `<tr>` rows with `<span class="shimmer-cell">` inside real `<td>` elements — same element/role as loaded content, no `aria-hidden`
- **Loaded state**: renders `row[col]` values derived from `Object.keys(rows[0])`
- **CSS**: shimmer animates only `opacity` (constraint: animate only `transform`/`opacity`), all colors use `--shelf-data-table-*` component tokens defined in both light and dark modes
